ayahs.1: Jab Allah ki madad aur fatah aa jaaye.
ayahs.2: Aur tu logon ko Allah ke deen mein jauq dar jauq aata dekh le.
ayahs.3: Tu apne Rabb ki tasbeeh karne lag hamd ke saath aur us se maghfirat ki dua maang, beshak woh bada hi tauba qubool karne wala hai.
